description: Disposable Hyper-V test VMs from a shared pool (vm_acquire, vm_start, vm_run, vm_read_out, vm_stop, vm_release, vm_status; pool_plan, pool_create, pool_resize, pool_remove, pool_status). Several agents at once, each run restored from a clean checkpoint, builds copied in from the project, network off by default. Needs its helper service set up once in an admin terminal (setup\install.cmd); every pool change is approved by the user in an admin terminal (cmd or PowerShell). Turn on only in a dedicated testing project: every agent in a project where it is on gets it. Requires Windows 11 Pro/Enterprise with Hyper-V, and Node 18+. Timings (optional env keys, default and range): HYPERV_MCP_GUEST_READY_MINUTES 10 (2-60), HYPERV_MCP_RESTORE_MINUTES 10 (2-30), HYPERV_MCP_OFF_WAIT_SECONDS 120 (20-600), HYPERV_MCP_RESTORE_VERIFY_SECONDS 180 (30-900), HYPERV_MCP_CHECKPOINT_MINUTES 10 (2-60), HYPERV_MCP_QUEUE_KEEP_MINUTES 10 (2-60), HYPERV_MCP_LOGON_MINUTES 10 (5-30), HYPERV_MCP_SHUTDOWN_MINUTES 5 (2-30), HYPERV_MCP_INSTALL_MINUTES 90 (30-360), HYPERV_MCP_PROVISION_MINUTES 30 (15-120), HYPERV_MCP_CLOUD_INIT_MINUTES 15 (5-60), HYPERV_MCP_COPY_IDLE_MINUTES 5 (1-9), HYPERV_MCP_NETWORK_SECONDS 90 (30-600), HYPERV_MCP_GUEST_SCRIPT_MINUTES 30 (1-360); see the README, Timings.
